int_name: N BROAD ST & W GODFREY AVE

result.summary: The intersection features wide multi-lane roadways with marked high-visibility crosswalks and pedestrian signals. However, the lack of a median refuge and the significant crossing distance increase pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane road requires pedestrians to cross a large distance without a refuge.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The intersection geometry allows for high-speed vehicle turns across pedestrian paths.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians mid-crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at corners to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: This is a large, multi-lane signalized intersection with significant crossing distances and minimal pedestrian protection. While sidewalks and signals are present, the environment is dominated by high-volume vehicle traffic and lacks physical buffers or traffic calming measures.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic on Broad Street without a median refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Faded Pavement Markings
hazards.description: The crosswalk and lane markings are significantly worn, reducing visibility for drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is immediately adjacent to high-speed travel lanes with no physical separation or furniture zone.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse markings with continental-style high-visibility markings.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide multi-lane roadway with marked continental crosswalks and pedestrian signals. However, the lack of a median refuge and the long crossing distance significantly increase exposure risk for pedestrians in this commercial environment.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least five lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.

hazards.name: Wide Lane Geometry
hazards.description: The wide, open roadway design encourages higher vehicle speeds, which increases the potential severity of collisions.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Visible cracking and wear in the asphalt surface could present minor tripping hazards or affect vehicle braking.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk and curb ramps, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure. However, the wide roadway and lack of visible pedestrian-specific signals or refuge islands increase exposure and risk for those crossing.
